description: Compare passport power: for 2-5 passports, how many destinations each can enter visa-free / on arrival / with e-visa or eTA / visa required (passport-ranking mobility comparison). With exactly 2 passports, also lists destinations where the requirements differ (up to 30). Data: Passport Index snapshot (2026-02-18). Example: visa_passport_compare({ passports: ["US", "India"] })

passports.description: 2-5 passports to compare — ISO2, ISO3, or country names, e.g. ["US", "IN"] or ["Germany", "Japan", "Singapore"]
